title: Reports
intro: The reports the system offers: choose a period, see the result within your access, export it to Excel and have it e-mailed on a schedule.
forbidden: Reports are for finance, procurement, executives, auditors and department heads. If you need a report, ask your department head.

scope.DEPT: Reports read only the departments you head

KPI.name: KPI G-1 to G-5
KPI.description: The system's goal measures, computed from the event log and the documents: POs through BCS, approvals by the DOA, speed, budget control and approvals on LINE.

proposalReports: The seven reports of the original proposal (R-01 to R-07) will be added once the customer confirms their list and definitions. The system does not build reports that have no definition yet.
periodInvalid: The chosen period cannot be used (it must start on or before its last day), so the last {days} days are shown instead.
caption: Result of the report {name}
kpiHint: The same figures as the KPI page, which explains each formula in words and opens the documents counted.
kpiLink: Open the KPI page for this period
exportHint: An Excel file of the same period and access as this page, with the file's checksum.
failed: The report could not be read. Choose the period again or reload the page.

measures.PO_APPROVED_OVER_ACCOUNTING_PURCHASES: POs approved ÷ purchase documents in the accounting system
measures.DECISIONS_WITH_DOA_REFERENCE: Decisions citing the DOA version and rule
measures.MEDIAN_SUBMIT_TO_FIRST_PO_HOURS: Median time from request to first approved PO
measures.TASKS_ON_FAILED_BUDGET_CHECK: Approval tasks of requests that failed the budget check
measures.DECISIONS_ON_LINE_ALL: Decisions on LINE or LIFF, all kinds of document

export.done: {count, plural, one {Exported # row} other {Exported # rows}}; the download has started.
export.openFailed: The file was made but the download did not open. Press Download this file again.

errors.TOO_MANY: One file holds at most {max} rows. Narrow the period or the conditions and export again.
errors.FILTER: These conditions cannot be exported. Check the dates and conditions and try again.
errors.FORBIDDEN: Your account may not export this file; your rights may have just changed. Reload the page to see them, and ask your organization admin if you still need the file.
errors.UNAUTHENTICATED: Your session has ended. Sign in again and retry.
errors.BUSY: The system is busy. Wait a moment and try again.
errors.CONFLICT: This press clashed with another command. Reload the page and try again.
errors.INTERNAL: Something went wrong and nothing was exported. Try again; if it still fails, tell your admin the reference {requestId}.
errors.FAILED: The export did not complete. Check your connection and try again.

schedule.title: E-mail reports on a schedule
schedule.intro: The system e-mails the report file to the recipients on the schedule you set. Each run covers the 30 days before it, within its creator's access. A recipient who may no longer read reports gets no more files.
schedule.itemMeta: {count, plural, one {# recipient} other {# recipients}} · set by {name} on {time}

cadences.MONTHLY: On the 1st of every month at 08:00

schedule.recipientsHint: Only people who may read the whole organization's reports themselves can be chosen, so the file never reaches someone who may not see it.
schedule.period: Each run sends the 30 days before the day it is sent.
schedule.done: Report scheduled: {cadence}, to {count, plural, one {# recipient} other {# recipients}}.

errors.RECIPIENTS: Choose at least one active recipient.
errors.RECIPIENT_SCOPE: Some recipients may no longer read this report themselves (their access may have changed). Reload the page and choose the recipients from the list again.
errors.CADENCE: Choose one of the schedules offered.
errors.REPORT: This report was not found. Choose a report from the list.
errors.FORBIDDEN: Only finance and executives may schedule reports.
errors.UNAUTHENTICATED: Your session has ended. Sign in again and retry.
errors.CONFLICT: This press clashed with another command. Reload the page and try again.
errors.BUSY: The system is busy with other work. Wait a moment and press schedule again.
errors.INTERNAL: Something went wrong and the schedule was not set. Try again; if it still fails, tell your admin the reference {requestId}.
errors.FAILED: The schedule was not set. Check your connection and try again.
